note:
Both before/after images on /pages/glutathione-research carried alt text saying 'more even-looking skin tone' / 'more even-looking skin' in all six languages, which breaks template §4 rule 6 (brightening only: never 'even tone' in our prose) and register fact 2 (the trial measured brightness, not evenness). Only that phrase changes; the rest of each description is kept word for word, and each locale uses the term the live page already uses for 'brighter-looking skin' (de 'heller wirkende Haut', es 'piel de aspecto más luminoso', fr 'peau d'apparence plus lumineuse', it 'pelle dall'aspetto più luminoso', nl 'helderder ogende huid').

File alt text is the MEDIA_IMAGE resource's single `alt` key (see configs/translations/page-philosophy-standards-image-alt.json). The English alt is changed first with fileUpdate (recorded in `english` below), then scripts/register-translations.py registers these five against the fresh digest.

These images are replaced in the template rollout (register §8.5, new before/after wave), so this fix is short-lived by design.

Undo: fileUpdate the English back to `english_before`, then register the old translations (kept in `translations_before`).
